prompt: If Princess Diana had been born three years earlier, who would have been Prime Minister when she was ten?
answer: Harold Wilson would have been Prime Minister. If Diana had been born three years earlier, on July 1, 1958, she would have been ten in 1968, when Wilson was serving as PM (1964–1970).
